' ============================================================================
'  Replaces sfrmProviderServiceCatalog with lstProviderServiceCatalog.
'
'    lstProviderServiceCatalog
'      ColumnCount    = 4
'      ColumnWidths   = "0;3520;1320;1760"   ' first col (PK) hidden
'      ColumnHeads    = True
'      BoundColumn    = 1
'      RowSourceType  = "Table/Query"
'      Tied to: frmProviderServiceCatalogDetail
' ============================================================================
Private Sub PopulateProviderServiceCatalog()
    If Me.NewRecord Or IsNull(Me.ProviderID) Then
        Me.lstProviderServiceCatalog.RowSource = ""
        Exit Sub
    End If
    Dim fy As Integer
    fy = Nz(Me.cboFilterFiscalYear, basUtilities.GetCurrentFiscalYear())
    Dim baseSql As String
    baseSql = _
        "SELECT psc.ProviderServiceCatalogID AS ID, " & _
               "s.ServiceName AS [Service], " & _
               "psc.FiscalYear AS FY, " & _
               "Format(psc.RatePerHour,'$#,##0.00') AS [Rate/Hr] " & _
        "FROM tblProviderServiceCatalog AS psc " & _
             "INNER JOIN tblServices AS s ON s.ServiceID = psc.ServiceID " & _
        "WHERE psc.ProviderID=" & Me.ProviderID & _
          " AND psc.FiscalYear=" & fy
    Me.lstProviderServiceCatalog.RowSource = basListHelpers.BuildAddableRowSource( _
        dataSelect:=baseSql, _
        addLabel:="(Add new catalog entry...)", _
        dataColCount:=4, _
        orderBy:="2")           ' by Service name
    Me.lstProviderServiceCatalog.Requery
End Sub
Private Sub lstProviderServiceCatalog_DblClick(Cancel As Integer)
    Dim ctx As String
    ctx = basListHelpers.BuildContextArgs( _
                "ProviderID", Me.ProviderID, _
                "FiscalYear", Nz(Me.cboFilterFiscalYear, basUtilities.GetCurrentFiscalYear()))
    basListHelpers.OpenDetailFromList Me.lstProviderServiceCatalog, _
                                      "frmProviderServiceCatalogDetail", _
                                      ctx
End Sub
' ============================================================================
'  Existing form logic (preserved)
' ============================================================================
Private Sub cboFilterFiscalYear_AfterUpdate()
    PopulateProviderServiceCatalog
    UpdateCopyButtonState
End Sub
Private Sub Form_Open(Cancel As Integer)
    If IsNull(Me.OpenArgs) Then Exit Sub
    If UCase(Me.OpenArgs) = "ADD" Then
        Me.DataEntry = True
    ElseIf IsNumeric(Me.OpenArgs) Then
        Dim rs As DAO.Recordset
        Set rs = Me.RecordsetClone
        rs.FindFirst "ProviderID=" & Me.OpenArgs
        If Not rs.NoMatch Then
            Me.Bookmark = rs.Bookmark
        End If
        Set rs = Nothing
    End If
End Sub
Private Sub Form_Current()
    Me.Caption = Nz(Me.txtProviderName, "New Provider") & " - Provider Detail"
    ' License expiration check
    If Not IsNull(Me.txtLicenseExpDate) Then
        If Me.txtLicenseExpDate < Date Then
            Me.lblLicenseWarning.Caption = "LICENSE EXPIRED"
            Me.lblLicenseWarning.ForeColor = RGB(255, 0, 0)
            Me.lblLicenseWarning.Visible = True
        ElseIf Me.txtLicenseExpDate < DateAdd("d", 90, Date) Then
            Me.lblLicenseWarning.Caption = "License expires soon"
            Me.lblLicenseWarning.ForeColor = RGB(255, 165, 0)
            Me.lblLicenseWarning.Visible = True
        Else
            Me.lblLicenseWarning.Visible = False
        End If
    Else
        Me.lblLicenseWarning.Visible = False
    End If
    m_IsDirty = False
    ' PK display: locked but visible (not grayed)
    Me.txtProviderID.Locked = True
    Me.txtProviderID.Enabled = True
    Me.txtProviderID.BorderStyle = 0
    Me.txtProviderID.TabStop = False
    ' Default the FY filter to whatever the combo's first item is.
    On Error Resume Next
    Me.cboFilterFiscalYear = Me.cboFilterFiscalYear.ItemData(1)
    On Error GoTo 0
    PopulateProviderServiceCatalog
    UpdateCopyButtonState
    On Error Resume Next
    Me.btnSave.Enabled = False
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub
Private Sub Form_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)
    If IsNull(Me.txtProviderName) Or Me.txtProviderName = "" Then
        MsgBox "Provider Name is required.", vbExclamation, "Validation"
        Me.txtProviderName.SetFocus
        Cancel = True
    End If
End Sub
Private Sub Form_Dirty(Cancel As Integer)
    m_IsDirty = True
    On Error Resume Next
    Me.btnSave.Enabled = True
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub
Private Sub Form_Undo(Cancel As Integer)
    m_IsDirty = False
    On Error Resume Next
    Me.btnSave.Enabled = False
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

Private Sub txtProviderName_Exit(Cancel As Integer)
    ' Trim was moved to txtProviderName_BeforeUpdate to avoid the Form_Dirty-poisoning
    ' quirk caused by self-assignment inside _Exit. See lessons-learned.md.
    ' Safe to delete this Sub entirely once the form's OnExit binding is cleared
    ' in Design View.
End Sub
Private Sub txtProviderName_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)
    ' Use .Text (in-progress edit), not .Value (locked during BeforeUpdate).
    Dim s As String
    s = Trim(Nz(Me.txtProviderName.Text, ""))
    If Len(s) > 0 Then
        If s <> Me.txtProviderName.Text Then
            Me.txtProviderName.Text = s
        End If
        ' Duplicate-name check (excluding this record)
        If DCount("*", "tblProviders", "ProviderName='" & _
                  Replace(s, "'", "''") & "' AND ProviderID<>" & _
                  Nz(Me.ProviderID, 0)) > 0 Then
            MsgBox "A provider with this name already exists.", vbExclamation, "Duplicate Name"
            Cancel = True
        End If
    End If
End Sub
Private Sub btnCopyCatalog_Click()
    ' Copies all service-catalog entries for this provider from the most
    ' recent populated prior FY into the FY currently selected in
    ' cboFilterFiscalYear. Replace-all semantics, single up-front prompt.
    Dim targetFY As Long
    targetFY = Nz(Me.cboFilterFiscalYear, basUtilities.GetCurrentFiscalYear())
    Dim srcVar As Variant
    srcVar = basDataOperations.MostRecentPopulatedFY( _
                "tblProviderServiceCatalog", _
                "ProviderID=" & Me.ProviderID, _
                targetFY)
    If IsNull(srcVar) Then
        MsgBox "No prior fiscal year has catalog entries to copy.", _
               vbInformation, "Nothing to Copy"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    Dim sourceFY As Integer
    sourceFY = CInt(srcVar)
    Dim srcCount As Long, tgtCount As Long
    srcCount = DCount("*", "tblProviderServiceCatalog", _
                      "ProviderID=" & Me.ProviderID & " AND FiscalYear=" & sourceFY)
    tgtCount = DCount("*", "tblProviderServiceCatalog", _
                      "ProviderID=" & Me.ProviderID & " AND FiscalYear=" & targetFY)
    Dim msg As String
    msg = "Copy " & srcCount & " catalog entry(ies) from FY" & sourceFY & _
          " into FY" & targetFY & "?"
    If tgtCount > 0 Then
        msg = msg & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
              "FY" & targetFY & " currently has " & tgtCount & _
              " catalog entry(ies) for this provider. They will be replaced."
    End If
    If MsgBox(msg, vbQuestion + vbOKCancel + vbDefaultButton1, _
              "Copy from FY" & sourceFY) <> vbOK Then
        Exit Sub
    End If
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Dim n As Long
    n = basDataOperations.CopyProviderCatalog( _
                Me.ProviderID, sourceFY, CInt(targetFY), overwrite:=True)
    MsgBox n & " catalog entry(ies) copied from FY" & sourceFY & _
           " to FY" & targetFY & ".", vbInformation, "Copy Complete"
    PopulateProviderServiceCatalog
    UpdateCopyButtonState
    Exit Sub
Failed:
    Select Case Err.Number
        Case basDataOperations.ERR_CANCELED
            ' silent
        Case basDataOperations.ERR_SAME_FY
            MsgBox Err.Description, vbExclamation, "Invalid Fiscal Years"
        Case Else
            MsgBox "Error copying catalog: " & Err.Description, vbCritical
    End Select
End Sub
' ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
'  Refreshes btnCopyCatalog's label and visibility based on the currently
'  selected target FY and what prior-year data exists for this provider.
' ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Private Sub UpdateCopyButtonState()
    On Error Resume Next   ' button may not exist yet during form load
    If Me.NewRecord Or IsNull(Me.ProviderID) Then
        Me.btnCopyCatalog.Visible = False
        Exit Sub
    End If
    Dim targetFY As Long
    targetFY = Nz(Me.cboFilterFiscalYear, basUtilities.GetCurrentFiscalYear())
    Dim srcVar As Variant
    srcVar = basDataOperations.MostRecentPopulatedFY( _
                "tblProviderServiceCatalog", _
                "ProviderID=" & Me.ProviderID, _
                targetFY)
    If IsNull(srcVar) Then
        Me.btnCopyCatalog.Visible = False
    Else
        Me.btnCopyCatalog.Caption = "Copy from FY" & CLng(srcVar)
        Me.btnCopyCatalog.Visible = True
    End If
End Sub

    DoCmd.Close acForm, Me.name
